name.zh: 艾莉丝警告一辉提防绫辻

periods.summary: Nagi warns Ikki that Ayase's request to meet alone may be a trap because she has no path to Seven Stars unless she beats him.
periods.cause: Ayase sends Ikki a message asking to meet alone on the school roof at 3 a.m.; she has avoided the group since learning she must fight him.
periods.process: Nagi notices Ikki has hidden the message and reasons that Ayase's goal requires defeating him despite the difference in strength. He advises Ikki to be ready to sever ties if necessary and avoid emotional disturbance like the Kirihara match.
periods.outcome: Ikki admits the message exists but chooses to go because he trusts Ayase and wants to help her.
periods.aftermath: Nagi reflects that Ikki, Stella and Shizuku's direct love and trust look dazzling compared with his own cynicism.
periods.significance: Frames Ikki's later choice to believe Ayase as deliberate rather than naive ignorance.
